scope: Graph Engineering runtime with first-class OpenCode and Pi reference hosts

coverage_percent.measurement_note: Final full-suite Node.js experimental coverage run after managed-install hardening and Pi agent_settled completion enforcement.

claims_not_made: No real OpenCode or Pi binary, authenticated model, or permission UI was exercised in this build environment.
Offline fake-host verification does not prove compatibility with an unpinned future host version.
No unattended workspace mutation, push, merge, PR, deployment, or production database action is approved.
known_residuals: Host extensions run with the OS permissions of the user account; ProofGraph policy is not kernel isolation.
Git worktrees isolate files, not network or operating-system resources.
Human identity inside one host remains self-attested rather than cryptographically attested.
OpenCode and Pi interfaces require version-pinned live canaries before production certification.
OpenCode pure_worker_confirmed is an operator attestation until a pinned live canary verifies the dedicated --pure worker server.
defects_found_and_fixed: OpenCode managed installation did not materialize the local plugin dependency in the config-root package manifest.
Host live preflight calculated an exact-version failure but overwrote it with the subprocess success flag.
Pi RPC previously allowed agent_end to become success before the documented agent_settled signal; completion now requires agent_settled and early exit fails closed.
The initial OpenCode target followed an unreleased development manifest; the release now pins the publicly installable stable CLI/server 1.18.4 and rejects unreviewed 1.18.5.
